connections.commonStructure: A digital twin can only issue cell-specific RUL when its observed state distinguishes cells that share the same imposed stress but later fail at different times.

variableMapping.physicalFrailty: unobserved manufacturing and early degradation susceptibility

connections.evidence: In 16 untouched same-condition cells, the capacity-response model produced concordance 0.4156 and worsened MdAE from 80.0 to 90.3 cycles.
connections.holdsWhen: The diagnostic is measured reproducibly and contains stable information about a later degradation mode.
connections.breaksWhen: Early fade is dominated by measurement variation or a mechanism that does not determine the later knee and EOL ordering.
connections.minimumValidation: A new lot must reproduce at least 0.65 held-cell concordance and calibrated uncertainty before the coordinate enters a cell-specific twin.
connections.transferableMethod: Separate cohort survival from individual frailty; abstain from individual ranking when the observed state fails a held-cell ordering gate.

connections.commonStructure: Accelerated-life stress laws estimate how a condition moves a population distribution; they do not automatically explain ordering among cells exposed to the same condition.

variableMapping.acceleratingStress: temperature, SOC, current, and voltage window

connections.evidence: RC54 ranked pooled lifetimes largely through stress while failing triplicate ordering; RC55 removed stress variation and the early capacity response still failed held-cell ordering.
connections.holdsWhen: Between-condition effects and within-condition random effects are estimated and validated on separate denominators.
connections.breaksWhen: Pooled stress discrimination is reported as individual prognostic accuracy.
connections.minimumValidation: Report both held-condition transport and at least 30 same-condition comparable pairs; neither denominator may substitute for the other.
connections.transferableMethod: Use a hierarchical survival model with a stress law for group location and an independently observed frailty state for within-group rank.

connections.commonStructure: A model cannot validate fine cell ordering when the endpoint is observed only at widely spaced RPTs and many cells share the same recorded EOL cycle.

variableMapping.measurementSchedule: roughly 160 aging cycles between capacity RPTs
variableMapping.identifiabilityLoss: 43 of 120 target pairs are tied and excluded from concordance

connections.evidence: The target supplied 77 comparable pairs, enough for the gate but too coarse to distinguish every cell pair.
connections.holdsWhen: Endpoint resolution is finer than the lifetime differences a twin or stress model claims to predict.
connections.breaksWhen: Interpolation or a learned smooth curve is mistaken for independently measured event-time precision.
connections.minimumValidation: Repeat on a source with at least one capacity observation per 50 cycles or validate a dense proxy against independent full-capacity RPTs.
connections.transferableMethod: Model interval censoring explicitly and align claimed prediction resolution with acquisition resolution.

promotedProgram.name: Stress–frailty separation with resolution-matched validation
promotedProgram.sharedBottleneck: Population stress effects, individual susceptibility, and interval-censored endpoints are conflated in many lifetime forecasts.
promotedProgram.minimumProgram: Fit the stress law and frailty observation on separate levels, preregister a same-condition ordering gate, preserve interval censoring, and require a new batch or laboratory for confirmation.
